## Activity

Capture activity at River Outreach during February 2023 came to 45 captures. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that services continued in line with the planned outreach arrangements, with no operational interruption reported beyond routine staff absence. Activity was recorded for the reporting period and is presented for review alongside the image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Graders marked 3 captures ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 6.7 per cent of all captures. The result should be considered when reviewing the overall performance of the session lists and the completeness of the captured material. No further cause for the ungradable images is recorded in the available report.

## Grading

There were 3 referable results. The median grading wait was 1 day. This provides a summary measure of the time between capture and completion of grading for the reporting period. The grading outcome should be read together with the ungradable rate, as both measures describe the quality and processing of the activity delivered at River Outreach during February 2023.
